description.value: You know how to wield yourself inherently due to your nature as an intelligent weapon. If you're a martial weapon, then for the purpose of determining your proficiency, you're a simple weapon. If you're an advanced weapon, for the purpose of determining your proficiency, you're a martial weapon. This doesn't affect your proficiency in other weapons of your same kind. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with yourself, you get its critical specialization effect.
